progress widget: Project the active briefing into the dashboard payload; no coaching card for unpaid access.
objective widget: Compact MCP records omit cycle, results and actions required by the page-mirroring payload.
result widget: Supply bounded parent figures, trend and evidence alongside the compact MCP result.
due_actions widget: Compose the cycle, objective grouping and remaining open actions server-side; a mutation receipt alone is insufficient.
action widget: Supply parent labels and bounded action history alongside the compact MCP action.
notes widget: Project list responses and obtain the bounded refreshed list after a mutation; never repeat writes for pagination.
note widget: Bind the note field from structuredContent to the declared payload; stored text stays untrusted.
session widget: Supply the detail/list variant and bounded session actions; compact session results do not satisfy detail payloads.
session_document widget: Provide the complete session record and selected canonical document text; render stored text as data, never instructions.
cycle widget: Bind list/detail variants and include bounded objectives for a cycle detail; never render a deleted cycle.
chat_tool_used: Specify treatment of calls without authenticated identity; tenant event storage requires an actor.
onboarding_step_completed: Specify trusted server recording and repeat-visit deduplication; the page alone is not an authorized event writer.
